comments.text: You can use your own personal insurance to cover the rental car for loss or damages with comprehensive coverage, indeed do your due diligence and ensure how your insurance works. Also, check with your credit card, they may have secondary insurance for rental cars, covering for damages and loss of use domestically and primary insurance if you rent a car outside the US. Albeit, a lot of the credit cards are ditching rental car coverage.
